subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about qualified property leads in the UK. Since OnTheMarket put £46.5m of sales and marketing behind its portal and lifted visits 55 percent, the audience you compete for is shifting, and cost-per-converted-lead across UK portals runs roughly 84 to 162 pounds, with conversion under 3 percent. That spread is where enquiry validation and incrementality decide your real cost per converted lead. We hold out a control group so the paid enquiries show as incremental to your organic search demand. Worth comparing against your current source mix?
angle: fresh angle: timely OnTheMarket investment (sourced) + UK cost-per-converted-lead band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN real_estate_proptech UK: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior; fresh angle = timely development (OnTheMarket's £46.5m sales/marketing investment lifting visits 55 percent, web-verified via propertywire) + REAL sourced UK cost-per-converted-lead band 84-162 pounds and sub-3 percent conversion (estateagentnetworking); OnTheMarket named from the parent's brand set; CoStar (cross-border owner) not named as a local rival; MobUpps holdout/incrementality reference carries no figure (no illustrative flag this stage); exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; no X-not-Y; no em-dash; no hedge before number.
